spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The githzerai casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

spellcasting.name: Psi-Powered Leap (2/Day)
headerEntries: The githzerai casts {@spell Jump|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Psionic Defense (2/Day)
headerEntries: The githzerai casts {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The githzerai makes two Psi Strike attacks.

action.name: Psi Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage.
